Re: Willful Copyright Infringement — Aurora Compass © 2023 (Reg. No. TX 9-224-118)
     Trademark Infringement of AURORA COMPASS® (Reg. No. 6,915,220)
     Our Client: Northlight Studios, Inc.

Dear Mr. Reyes:

This firm represents Northlight Studios, Inc. ("Northlight") in connection with the video game Aurora Compass ("the Work"), released September 12, 2023. Northlight owns all right, title, and interest in the Work, including the copyright in the audiovisual work, screenplay, musical score, and character designs, as well as the registered trademark AURORA COMPASS® for computer game software in International Class 9.

It has come to our client's attention that Vantablack Interactive, LLC ("Vantablack") is currently distributing a mobile game titled "Aurora Trail" (available on the Apple App Store and Google Play as of April 4, 2026) that infringes multiple protected works owned by Northlight, including without limitation:

1. Verbatim reproduction of at least 41 seconds of the orchestral cue "Northbound" composed by Dr. Ines Marchetta, appearing at 00:12–00:53 of Aurora Trail's main menu theme, as confirmed by independent musicological analysis by Prof. Kenji Okuma (report dated May 15, 2026).

2. Substantially similar character design and name for the protagonist "Kaia Solheim," a copyrighted character first published in Chapter 2 of the Work on September 12, 2023.

3. Confusingly similar trade dress, including the parallax star-field animation and compass-rose interface elements, likely to cause consumer confusion under the Lanham Act.

4. Use of the mark "AURORA" in connection with an interactive entertainment product, in a manner likely to cause confusion, mistake, or deception as to source, sponsorship, or affiliation with Northlight.

DEMAND
Northlight demands that Vantablack, no later than 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time on June 5, 2026:

(a) Immediately cease all distribution, sale, offer for sale, marketing, and promotion of Aurora Trail;
(b) Remove the application from all digital storefronts, including Apple App Store, Google Play, and any third-party mirrors;
(c) Deliver a written accounting of all revenues, downloads, and derivative works generated by Aurora Trail from launch date through the date of removal;
(d) Preserve all documents, source code, communications, and financial records related to the design, development, marketing, and distribution of Aurora Trail;
(e) Provide written confirmation of compliance signed by an officer of Vantablack under penalty of perjury.

Should Vantablack fail to comply, Northlight is prepared to pursue all available remedies, including:
• Statutory damages of up to $150,000 per willfully infringed work under 17 U.S.C. § 504(c)(2);
• Actual damages and disgorgement of Vantablack's profits;
• Injunctive relief under 17 U.S.C. § 502 and 15 U.S.C. § 1116;
• Attorneys' fees and costs under 17 U.S.C. § 505 and 15 U.S.C. § 1117.

This letter is not intended to enumerate all of Northlight's rights or remedies, all of which are expressly reserved.

Sincerely,
/s/ Fiona J. Marlowe
Fiona J. Marlowe
